If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending up, cap upward movement at 1.0–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% downward bias for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a 3-day downtrend, adjust forecast upward by 1.0–2.0% for next 5 days.  
If sentiment drops below 0.33 after a 3-day uptrend, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% for next 7 days.  
If sentiment is 0.67–1.00 and forecast is above 75.00, apply 0.5–1.0% downward correction for late horizon to avoid over-optimism.
